description: Allbound channel plan: the same contact gets email, LinkedIn and call steps while their account sits in ad audiences on every platform. firstTouch runs for a new account; followUp runs when someone at an account we already emailed engages again (a post like, profile view, ad click, ...), together with retargeting ads. Steps are planned for a sequencer; a person signs off before any of them reach the prospect. founderPostAds picks which founder posts to run as ads.
